items.source: this Search instance for chained method invocations
items.translation: 此Search实例用于链式方法调用。

items.source: Enclosing classes will be recursively searched if the supplied Predicate evaluates to true. Typically, the predicate will be used to differentiate between inner classes and static nested classes.
items.translation: 如果提供的Predicate评估为true，将递归搜索包含类。通常，该谓词用于区分内部类和static嵌套类。

items.source: WARNING: if the supplied predicate always evaluates to true, the algorithm will search recursively for annotations on an enclosing class for any source type, regardless whether the source type is an inner class, a static nested class, or a nested interface. Thus, it may find more annotations than you would expect.
items.translation: 警告： 如果提供的谓词始终评估为true，该算法将递归地在外部类中搜索任何源类型的注解，无论该源类型是否为 内部类、static 嵌套类还是嵌套接口。因此，它可能会找到比您预期的更多的注解。

items.source: This feature is disabled by default and is only supported when using MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy.TYPE_HIERARCHY.
items.translation: 此功能默认处于禁用状态，仅在使用 MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy.TYPE_HIERARCHY 时支持。

items.source: Defaults to RepeatableContainers.standardRepeatables().
items.translation: 默认为RepeatableContainers.standardRepeatables()。

items.source: Defaults to AnnotationFilter.PLAIN.
items.translation: 默认为AnnotationFilter.PLAIN。

items.source: For example, the following performs a search on MyClass within the entire type hierarchy of that class while ignoring repeatable annotations.
items.translation: 例如，以下操作会在该类的整个类型层次结构中搜索 `<code>MyClass`》，同时忽略可重复注解。

items.source: If you wish to reuse search configuration to perform the same type of search on multiple elements, you can save the Search instance as demonstrated in the following example.
items.translation: 如果您希望重用搜索配置以在多个元素上执行相同类型的搜索，您可以按照以下示例所示保存 `Search` 实例。

items.source: Perform a search for merged annotations beginning with the supplied AnnotatedElement (such as a Class or Method), using the configuration in this Search instance.
items.translation: 执行搜索，查找以提供的 `AnnotatedElement（例如 `Class` 或 `Method`）开头的合并注解，使用此 `Search` 实例中的配置。

items.source: Configure the AnnotationFilter to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: Configure the RepeatableContainers to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的RepeatableContainers。

items.source: Configuration starts with an invocation of MergedAnnotations.search(SearchStrategy), specifying which MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy to use.
items.translation: 配置以调用 `MergedAnnotations.search(SearchStrategy)` 开始，指定要使用的哪个 `MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy`。

items.source: a new MergedAnnotations instance containing all annotations and meta-annotations from the specified element and, depending on the MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy, related inherited elements
items.translation: 一个包含指定元素的所有注解和元注解的新MergedAnnotations实例，并且根据MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy，包含相关的继承元素。

items.source: The actual search is performed by invoking from(AnnotatedElement) with the source element from which the search should begin.
items.translation: 实际的搜索是通过调用from(AnnotatedElement)来执行的，并传入应开始搜索的源元素。

items.source: To limit the enclosing class search to inner classes, provide ClassUtils::isInnerClass as the predicate.
items.translation: 要将包围类搜索限制为内部类，请提供 ClassUtils::isInnerClass 作为谓词。

items.source: To limit the enclosing class search to static nested classes, provide ClassUtils::isStaticClass as the predicate.
items.translation: 要将包围类搜索限制为静态内部类，请提供 ClassUtils::isStaticClass 作为谓词。

items.source: searchEnclosingClass - a predicate which evaluates to true if a search should be performed on the enclosing class of the class supplied to the predicate
items.translation: searchEnclosingClass - 一个谓词，如果应在提供给该谓词的类的包围类上执行搜索，则求值为 true。

items.source: Optional configuration can be provided via one of the with*() methods.
items.translation: 可选配置可以通过其中一个 `with*()` 方法提供。

items.source: To force the algorithm to always search enclosing classes, provide clazz -> true as the predicate.
items.translation: 要强制算法始终搜索包含类，请提供 `clazz -> true` 作为谓词。

items.source: repeatableContainers - the repeatable containers that may be used by annotations or meta-annotations
items.translation: repeatableContainers - 注解或元注解可能使用的可重复容器

items.source: For any other use case, provide a custom predicate.
items.translation: 对于任何其他用例，请提供自定义谓词。

items.source: Configure whether the search algorithm should search on enclosing classes.
items.translation: 配置是否让搜索算法在外部类中进行搜索。

items.source: annotationFilter - an annotation filter used to restrict the annotations considered
items.translation: annotationFilter - 用于限制所考虑注解的注解过滤器

items.source: element - the source element
items.translation: element - 源元素

items.source: Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Phillip Webb，Sam Brannen
